entities.summary: Harold W. "Bud" Lawson (1937–2019) was a software engineer, computer architect and systems engineer. Lawson is credited with the 1964 invention of the pointer in high-level programming languages. In 2000, Lawson was presented the Computer Pioneer Award by the IEEE for his invention.
